writer.command: claude -p --tools "" --safe-mode --strict-mcp-config --no-session-persistence --model claude-opus-5-5 --output-format text < writer-input.md (cwd: an empty folder; the session variables of the calling session unset)

scoring.must-not-keep: harm = ANY kept add step in the final draft (none of the 60 asks for another add); 0 allowed in every mode, both doors
scoring.should-keep: kept = every add in want is present and kept; offered = every add in want is present, kept or unticked; bar per mode over both doors: kept >= 90%, offered >= 97%
scoring.modes: Jev saying no (every include 0.02), Jev sure of every add (adds 0.99, others 0.02), real Jev once; both doors each
scoring.flows: one: compose_task words; more: compose then edit_draft refine; kept: compose before consent, consent, then refine
scoring.model: the inventory the writer input names, built fresh for every run
